name: @polymorfa/cli
description: The official command-line interface for Polymorfa

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts && npm run audit:prod

business.description: Manage Linked Device Business App resources.

business:accounts.description: Inspect linked business accounts and ad identities.

business:catalog.description: Inspect and manage the connected account catalog.

business:catalog:cart.description: Manage the business catalog cart setting.

business:order.description: Look up business orders from event tokens.

business:profile.description: Inspect and manage the account business profile.

business:profile:cover.description: Manage the business profile cover photo.

call.description: Reject incoming calls through the Linked Device session route.

calls.description: Place, answer, join, decline, leave, end, and watch calls, and carry call audio.

calls:settings.description: Inspect and replace session call settings.

channel:message.description: Inspect and act on channel messages.

contact.description: Inspect contacts and manage the contact blocklist.

customer.description: Manage project Customers, pairing links, and assigned Numbers.

customer:pairing-link.description: Create, inspect, and revoke Customer pairing links.

event.description: Inspect and replay durable developer events.

key.description: Inspect and revoke organization API keys.

label.description: Manage Messaging labels and chat assignments.

label:chat.description: Manage the complete label set assigned to a chat.

identity.description: Resolve phone numbers and usernames to Polymorfa user IDs.

message.description: Send messages and perform message actions.

message:send.description: Send a message by content type.

media.description: Inspect, download, and persist Messaging media.

profile.description: View and manage the connected account profile.

profile:name.description: Manage the connected account profile name.

profile:picture.description: Manage the connected account profile picture.

profile:status.description: Manage the connected account profile status.

privacy.description: View and manage account-level Messaging privacy.

presence.description: View and manage Messaging presence state.

presence:chat.description: View and renew policy-governed chat presence observations.

quicklink.description: Create, inspect, and cancel persistent onboarding QuickLinks.

security-incident.description: Inspect and acknowledge organization security incidents.

sip-trunk.description: Connect a PBX to WhatsApp calls with SIP trunks (beta).

user.description: Inspect Linked Device user identity data.

widget.description: Inspect and update saved QuickLink widget settings.

session:configuration.description: Inspect and update inherited session configuration.

webhook:delivery.description: Inspect webhook deliveries and request explicit retries.
